text:
sophia: Planning launch post + webinar next Thu. Need changelog PR, anchors for blog CTAs, and a 1.5h canary. Can eng/docs land by Tue EOD?
ben: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4810 \\ changelog: docs/changes/2026-03-15-adaptive.md. Canary pref: Thu 08:30-10:00 PT.
sophia: Marketing wants anchors for 'adaptive batching' and 'cost guidance' so CTAs can link directly. Also a short example payload for the inbound form.
rita: I'll add anchors: "Adaptive batching" -> #adaptive-batching and "Cost guidance" -> #cost-guidance. Will include sample JSON for the form and contact snippet. PR to docs in ~90m.
ben: We'll mention automatic fallback to lower-cost quantized variants under peak load. Ops: @deploy-bot can you reserve the canary and tag the RC?
deploy-bot: Canary reserved: 2026-03-18T08:30:00-07:00 to 2026-03-18T10:00:00-07:00. Tag created: rc/2026-03-18-adaptive.
owen: Growth will wire the nurture form to /docs/dedicated/try and tag leads with "interested-adaptive". Will run a dry test post-docs-merge.
sophia: Timeline: docs + changelog merged by Tue 23:00 UTC, canary Thu 08:30-10:00 PT, public announce Thu 10:30 PT, webinar Fri 16:00 UTC. Deck due Wed 18:00 UTC.
ben: Good from eng. Quick merge steps:
```
# land changelog
git fetch origin
git checkout main
git cherry-pick d4c5e1b
git push origin main
```
sophia: Thanks all  I'll update calendar and draft the post using the exact anchors. If canary shows regressions we delay by 2h and push webinar-only note.
